text.p: Safeskin Corp, a maker of latex examination gloves, said Monday it was one of two companies that won a five-year contract that could generate combined sales of $80 to $90 million a year.
The contract was awarded by Premier Purchasing Partners LP, the largest hospital alliance in the United States and a provider of medical products to 1,800 facilities.
Safeskin's gloves will begin to be sold by Premier in the first quarter of 1997, it said.
Shares of Safeskin were up 1-7/8 to 49 at midday.

"Safeskin will now have entry into a vast number of hospitals only accessible through this purchasing agreement," Richard Jaffe, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "In the current managed care environment, large contracts such as the Premier contract are critical for continued growth."
